data.long_meaning: The Norse name Karin means 'pure one' or 'dear one'. It is derived from the Old Norse word 'karr', which means 'dear' or 'pure'. In Norse mythology, the name Karin is associated with the goddess Freya, who is the goddess of love, fertility, and war. The name Karin carries the meaning “Pure One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Karin usually hope their child will grow to embody pure one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
